weekend_race.race_comments: Kyle Busch won the Fr8 Racing 208 at EchoPark Speedway, his 68th NASCAR CRAFTSMAN Truck Series victory.  Prior to the start the following car(s) dropped to the rear of the field under penalty for the reason indicated: No. 9 (inspection failure: unapproved splitter), Nos. 12, 18, 26, 17 (unapproved adjustments).
